static_traits.name: Zhou Baolin
static_traits.social_status: Relationships with other Photographers and clients strained due to Self-doubt and lack of confidence; has a few Photographer friends to talk to, but struggles to open up about unease and Self-doubt
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness history; never received psychotherapy before; no prior history of similar problems
static_traits.language_features: Tone is negative; can clearly express experiences and feelings; has repetitive negative self-talk; skeptical about change but willing to try; cooperation acceptable

basic_info.main_problem: After accidentally breaking a camera lens today, I feel I am a terrible Photographer, triggering intense incompetence and Self-doubt. These feelings appear whenever facing setbacks or mistakes in photography and have gradually worsened, affecting my motivation to shoot and enjoyment of photography.
basic_info.core_demands: 'This camera incident made me realize the extent of my negative self-talk and how it affects my passion and livelihood, prompting me to seek counseling.'; 'I am just tired of always feeling this way.'

special_situations.event: Accidentally breaking the camera lens today
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I make a mistake, it proves I am not competent enough and a terrible Photographer
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Trying to rationalize and focus on the positive aspects of the work, but negative feelings still prevail
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am a terrible Photographer; I am too careless

special_situations.event: Whenever encountering setbacks or mistakes in photography
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Every setback proves I am not suited for this profession and will never be good enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeated self-criticism, Decreased motivation to shoot
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Every setback proves I am not suited for photography

special_situations.event: Interacting and collaborating with other Photographers and clients
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Relationship tension is because I am not good enough, which means something is wrong with me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding opening up about unease to friends, reducing help-seeking and communication
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: It is all because I am not good enough that relationships worsened

special_situations.event: Reviews own work and tries to attend to positive performance
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Positive experiences do not matter; mistakes best reveal the problem
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tries to record/recall good photography experiences (e.g. client praise last month), but finds it hard to maintain positive feelings
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: The good ones do not count; today's mistake shows I am not capable

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized through photography, maintain a sense of competence and self-worth (photography is the core of self-identity)
core_conflict.fear: Fear that mistakes and failure will prove one's incompetence, losing self-identity and livelihood
defense_goal: Maintaining a sense of control and reducing the risk of being judged through harsh self-criticism and avoiding opening up about unease

object_relations.object_representation: Others (clients/colleagues) may be picky evaluators who will be disappointed or critical

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor challenges and restructures negative beliefs and suggests recording positive experiences
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing these methods have limited effect on oneself, that one's negative thoughts are 'deeply rooted', and change is unlikely
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Acknowledging the skeptical feelings, using supportive, concretized Questioning to Guidance back to actual experience; gentle, non-judgmental tone, inviting small-step verification and evidence review.

manifestations: Viewing photography as an important part of self and life meaning; once failing (like breaking the lens), feeling 'completely useless'
Enjoyment and passion for photography decline; hard to stay connected to positive experiences
Struggling to open up about unease and Self-doubt to Photographer friends
Relationship tension with clients and peers

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: Frequent self-criticism (such as 'I am an absolute failure / not good enough')
Withdrawing and Withdrawal in interactions due to Self-doubt

contact_model.definition: The individual turns the energy originally meant to be directed outward onto themselves, changing what they wanted to do to others or the environment into doing it to themselves.
manifestations: Struggling to ask friends for help or express unease, turning to self-blame and self-attack
After making a mistake, turns anger/disappointment into self-punishing negative self-talk

exception_events.target_problem: When facing photography setbacks or mistakes, the client usually sinks into intense negative self-talk and Self-doubt, Decreased motivation, affecting shooting and income.
exception_events.unique_outcome: A shoot last month went smoothly; the client was very satisfied and recommended her to friends, which she felt Good about.
exception_events.reason: Clues: different support and situation — the shoot went smoothly, the client gave positive feedback and recommendations; different experience — the successful experience briefly boosted confidence and connection.

positive_force: Full of passion for photography (photography is the passion and main income source)
Has experience of successful works and client recommendations (filmed last month)
Having a few Photographer friends to talk to
negative_force: Intense negative self-talk, Self-denial whenever making mistakes
Has cognitive distortions such as black-and-white thinking and mental filtering
Self-doubt leading to Decreased motivation and Impaired occupational functioning
Struggling to open up about unease to the Social support system, Interpersonal tension

target_behavior.behavior: Repeated negative self-talk (such as 'I am a terrible Photographer')
antecedent: Encountering setbacks or making mistakes in photography
target_behavior.core_reason: Overly binding self-worth to occupational performance, taking a black-and-white / catastrophic Interpretation of mistakes, reinforcing incompetence
target_behavior.function: Self-punishes and tries to gain a sense of control through self-blame, while avoiding directly facing the emotions brought by failure
target_behavior.consequence: Low mood and Intensifying self-doubt, Decreased motivation to shoot, impaired occupational performance and income

antecedent: When a mistake happens or one thinks of erring again
target_behavior.core_reason: Worrying that failure will prove oneself unsuited for photography, avoiding shame and Anxiety experiences
target_behavior.function: Avoiding negative evaluation and potential failure
target_behavior.consequence: Unable to stabilize Work and income, missing opportunities, Career development hindered

target_behavior.behavior: Avoiding opening up about unease to friends/peers in social interactions
antecedent: Situations involving one's own unease and confidence issues when communicating with Photographer friends or clients
target_behavior.core_reason: Fearing that exposing vulnerability will be looked down upon or rejected, attributing Interpersonal tension to oneself not being good enough
target_behavior.function: Avoids being judged, maintains surface control and a sense of safety
target_behavior.consequence: Reduced social support, Relationship tension worsening the sense of Loneliness, further maintaining the negative emotion and cognition cycle
